title: Leica TS13 Robotic Total Station
summary:
The TS13 starts as a two-person instrument and becomes a one-person robotic system when you add the keyboard, follow-me lock, SpeedSearch, and radio connectivity. Angular accuracy comes in 1, 2, 3, and 5 second versions, so the same family covers a stakeout crew and a control crew.

AutoHeight measures the instrument height for you, ATR locks onto the target automatically to 1,000 m with a circular prism, and EGL guides the operator to the point. Single prism accuracy is 1 mm + 1 ppm, typically 2.4 seconds, and non-prism reaches beyond 1,000 m.

The TS13 is a named sensor in the Leica X-PAD portfolio, so a crew already running X-PAD on a GS05 or GS11 keeps one interface, one dataset per job, and one data format (HeXML) across GNSS and total station. It runs Leica Captivate as well: Captivate for maximum capability and specialised applications, X-PAD for the focused everyday routines.
specs: Angular accuracy 1, 2, 3 and 5 seconds (horizontal and vertical)
Prism range 0.9-3,500 m; non-prism above 500 m (R500) and above 1,000 m (R1000)
Single prism 1 mm + 1 ppm, typically 2.4 s; prism fast 2 mm + 1 ppm, typically 1.5 s; single any surface 2 mm + 2 ppm, typically 2 s
ATR automatic target aiming to 1,000 m with a circular prism and 800 m with a 360 degree prism; ATR angle accuracy equals instrument accuracy
EGL guide light 5-150 m, typically 5 cm at 100 m
AutoHeight instrument-height measurement, 1.0 mm accuracy over 0.7-2.7 m
Laser dot 8 x 20 mm at 50 m
5.0 kg including battery (5.3 kg in the robotic configuration); Li-ion up to 8 h; IP55, operating -20 to +50 degrees C
accessories: Robotic upgrade kit: keyboard, follow-me lock and radio/controller connectivity
Field controller running Leica Captivate or Leica X-PAD
Leica CSX8 controller tablet for Leica X-PAD
Leica GS11 or GS05 GNSS smart antenna for a hybrid GNSS and total station setup: the total station tracks a prism on the antenna
Prism pole with prism, mini prism, and prism holder
